method: textspot_a9.py measure --out DIR [--shapes s4_c8,...] [--scales h2,f1] [--sizes 960x544,480x272]                          [--formats grey] [--nodark] [--cflags "-O2"] [--seed 1] [--jobs 5] [--vitasdk DIR]                          [--arm-cc GCC] [--qemu DIR]   textspot_a9.py report DIR [--json eval/textspot_a9_YYYYMMDD.json] [--also DIR2 --also-label TEXT ...]

tools.vita_cc: arm-vita-eabi-gcc (GNU Tools for ARM Embedded Processors) 15.2.0

note: estimates: qemu-arm instruction counts priced by vita/a9_cycles.py's Cortex-A9 model, not a console measurement; est. ms @333 = high bound x 1.0007 / 333 MHz, est. ms @444 = that x 333/444; arena bytes are exact (the runtime's functions)

rule_reads.arena: arena_up_to_960 = vocr_textspot_arena_bytes(m, 960, 544): every frame up to 960x544 (for h2, the 600-px frame read at full size dominates); arena_frame_960 = vocr_textspot_frame_arena_bytes(m, 960, 544), the 960x544 frame's own need, is report only (the conductor, 2026-10-19)
rule_reads.time: ms_333_960: the default call (flags 0, the dark pass included) on the pinned 960x544 grey frame; ms_333_960_nodark (VOCR_TEXTSPOT_NO_DARK) is report only
rule_reads.within_limits: ms_333_960 <= ms_max_333_960 and arena_up_to_960 <= arena_max (for det; det+refine adds the refinement's arena and 1.4 ms per refined line, eval/textspot_metrics.apply_rule)

also.label: VOCR_TEXTSPOT_NO_DARK (report only): the same blobs and frames, no dark pass (Rubi's scan-screen read)
the spotter at -Os, NEON (report only): 960x544 grey
the spotter at -Os -DVOCR_NO_NEON, the smallest Vita build (report only): 960x544 grey
RGBA frames (report only): the same frames as R = G = B = grey, alpha 255, 960x544
